title: Mysterious Lights in UAE Sky Solved by New Train Stations

content:
News September 29, 2026 at 3:59 pm

Abu Dhabi & Dubai Folks Saw A Mysterious Light In The Sky Last Night

Last night, residents across Abu Dhabi and Dubai were treated to a spectacular, albeit mysterious, light show in the sky! Folks everywhere were scratching their heads, wondering where these dazzling beams could possibly be coming from. It was the talk of the town, with everyone trying to solve the puzzle of the glowing heavens.

Well, the mystery has been officially solved, and it’s even cooler than you imagined! The brilliant lights that lit up the night sky actually came from the brand-new Etihad Rail Dubai Station, specifically the Al Yalayis Station, which had its grand opening just yesterday.

Not to be outdone, Abu Dhabi’s very own Etihad Rail Abu Dhabi Station also joined in on the fun, adding to the nationwide spectacle! The Al Dhafra Al Hamed & Al Zayed City Station lit up with its own mesmerizing display, ensuring that the capital was just as bright and celebratory. It was a fantastic show of unity and excitement, with both emirates shining bright for all to see.

The national rail network has just hit a major milestone

UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed actually took the train all the way from Abu Dhabi to Dubai to mark the occasion, and Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed inaugurated the brand-new Etihad Rail Dubai station.

During his ride, the UAE President was briefed on the train’s operating system, checked out the passenger services, and met with the national team working behind the scenes. Sheikh Hamdan also gave us a sneak peek of his ticket. He posted a ride from Dubai to Abu Dhabi taking just 1 hour and 2 minutes!

If you’re looking to hop on board yourself, full passenger services between Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and Fujairah officially launch on September 30, 2026. You can already book tickets on the Etihad Rail app or website, with prices starting at just 39 dirhams for Comfort Class and 109 dirhams for Premium Class.
